page: Microsoft Azure M12ds_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MDSMediumMemoryv3 server family. Built on the x86_64 architecture with Intel processors, this instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It provides 12 dedicated vCPUs paired with 240.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a high resource density of 20.0 GB of RAM per core.

The server includes 410 GB of local SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses and features no onboard GPU hardware.

With a memory-to-CPU ratio of 20:1, the M12ds_v3 offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require massive memory footprints relative to compute requirements, avoiding the need to provision excess vCPUs just to obtain sufficient RAM. This profile is highly suitable for memory-intensive applications, large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, and enterprise resource planning systems.
